Purchased CBR650R 20 months ago. Rust has already appeared on the exhaust pipe and some bolts. Expected much better quality from Honda brand. Nawabi city mein style bhi chaiye.

CB350 Hness ki quality ekdum bekar hai yaar. 3 mahine mein: paint fade ho gayi sun mein, plastic trim creak karta hai, rear suspension noise karta hai bumps pe, fuel cap loose ho gayi, handlebar rubber grip tear ho gayi. Har chota problem ke liye service center jaao, ghante wait karo, 500-1000 rupees deke aao. Ek baar mein hi sab fix nahi karte. Honda ke naam se jo trust tha woh completely shatter ho gaya.

My CB350RS has serious heat management issues. The engine area generates tremendous heat even in normal riding conditions. In summer months riding in Delhi traffic becomes a nightmare. My right leg is constantly exposed to engine heat. Have complained multiple times but service center says it's by design. At this price point I expected Honda to have figured out better thermal management. Competition handles this much better.

I am extremely disappointed with CB350 Hness. The after-sales service network is pathetic. Nearest authorized service center is 40km from my location and they have a waiting period of 10-15 days for even basic service. Parts availability is poor. Had to wait 3 weeks for a simple brake cable replacement. Honda really needs to expand and improve their service infrastructure before charging premium prices for their products. Chennai heat mein pass kiya test. Ghar ke sab kaam ek bike se.
